88  def _page_match_score(query: str, title: str) -> float:
   89      normalized_query = _normalize(query)
   90      normalized_title = _normalize(title)
   91      if not normalized_query or not normalized_title:
   92          return 0.0
   93      if normalized_query == normalized_title:
   94          return 1.0
   95  
   96      query_tokens = set(_tokens(normalized_query))
   97      title_tokens = set(_tokens(normalized_title))
   98      if not query_tokens or not title_tokens:
   99          return 0.0
  100  
  101      # A title phrase contained in a natural-language question is stronger than
  102      # isolated token overlap, but the overlap must still be visible.
  103      if normalized_title in normalized_query:
  104          return 0.9
  105      if normalized_query in normalized_title:
  106          return 0.85
  107  
  108      overlap = query_tokens & title_tokens
  109      if not overlap:
  110          return 0.0
  111      if len(title_tokens) == 1 or len(query_tokens) == 1:
  112          return 0.65 if overlap else 0.0
  113  
  114      title_coverage = len(overlap) / len(title_tokens)
  115      query_coverage = len(overlap) / len(query_tokens)
  116  
  117      if len(overlap) >= 2 and (title_coverage >= 0.35 or query_coverage >= 0.4):
  118          return 0.55 + (0.25 * max(title_coverage, query_coverage))
  119      if len(overlap) == 1 and title_coverage >= 0.5:
  120          return 0.50
  121      return 0.0

1  """Provider-neutral Approval contracts and deterministic action identity."""
    2  
    3  from __future__ import annotations
    4  
    5  import json
    6  from collections.abc import Mapping
    7  from copy import deepcopy
    8  from enum import StrEnum
    9  from typing import Any
   10  from uuid import UUID, uuid5
   11  
   12  from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, SchemaError, ValidationError
   13  
   14  from packages.core.canonical.json_hash import canonical_json_hash
   15  
   16  
   17  class ApprovalDecisionStatus(StrEnum):
   18      PENDING = "PENDING"
   19      APPROVED = "APPROVED"
   20      DENIED = "DENIED"
   21      EXPIRED = "EXPIRED"
   22      CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"
   23  
   24  
   25  class ApprovalExecutionStatus(StrEnum):
   26      NOT_STARTED = "NOT_STARTED"
   27      CLAIMED = "CLAIMED"
   28      SUCCEEDED = "SUCCEEDED"
   29      FAILED = "FAILED"
   30      UNKNOWN_OUTCOME = "UNKNOWN_OUTCOME"
   31  
   32  
   33  class ApprovalTransitionError(ValueError):
   34      """Raised when a decision or execution state transition is not legal."""
   35  
   36  
   37  _RESERVED_ARGUMENT_KEYS = frozenset(
   38      {
   39          "workspace_id",
   40          "organization_id",
   41          "user_id",
   42          "requested_by",
   43          "decided_by",
   44          "approver",
   45          "logical_action_id",
   46          "idempotency_key",
   47          "execution_status",
   48          "decision_status",
   49      }
   50  )
   51  
   52  
   53  def canonicalize_arguments(
   54      arguments: Mapping[str, Any], input_schema: Mapping[str, Any]
   55  ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
   56      """Validate and freeze business arguments before an Approval is created."""
   57  
   58      if not isinstance(arguments, Mapping):
   59          raise ValueError("tool arguments must be an object")
   60      _reject_reserved_keys(arguments)
   61      try:
   62          Draft202012Validator.check_schema(dict(input_schema))
   63          validator = Draft202012Validator(dict(input_schema))
   64          validator.validate(arguments)
   65      except (SchemaError, ValidationError) as exc:
   66          raise ValueError("tool arguments do not match the published input schema") from exc
   67      normalized = deepcopy(dict(arguments))
   68      # Round-trip through JSON ensures that the persisted projection is JSON-safe and
   69      # removes custom Mapping implementations before hashing or persistence.
   70      try:
   71          normalized = json.loads(
   72              json.dumps(normalized, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
   73          )
   74      except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   75          raise ValueError("tool arguments are not JSON serializable") from exc
   76      if not isinstance(normalized, dict):
   77          raise ValueError("tool arguments must be an object")
   78      return normalized, canonical_json_hash(normalized)
   79  
   80  
   81  def _reject_reserved_keys(value: Any) -> None:
   82      if isinstance(value, Mapping):
   83          if any(str(key) in _RESERVED_ARGUMENT_KEYS for key in value):
   84              raise ValueError("tool arguments contain reserved internal fields")
   85          for child in value.values():
   86              _reject_reserved_keys(child)
   87      elif isinstance(value, list):
   88          for child in value:
   89              _reject_reserved_keys(child)
   90  
   91  
   92  def compute_logical_action_id(
   93      *,
   94      workspace_id: UUID | str,
   95      run_id: UUID | str,
   96      tool_revision_id: UUID | str | None,
   97      canonical_args_hash: str,
   98      proposal_ordinal: int,
   99  ) -> str:
  100      """Return a deterministic identity independent of provider tool-call IDs."""
  101  
  102      if proposal_ordinal < 0:
  103          raise ValueError("proposal ordinal must be non-negative")
  104      identity = {
  105          "workspace_id": str(workspace_id),
  106          "run_id": str(run_id),
  107          "tool_revision_id": str(tool_revision_id) if tool_revision_id is not None else None,
  108          "canonical_args_hash": canonical_args_hash,
  109          "proposal_ordinal": proposal_ordinal,
  110      }
  111      return str(uuid5(UUID("7f2e2f1e-0f1b-5df3-9d8f-5a3bbf1b3c31"), canonical_json_hash(identity)))
  112  
  113  
  114  def transition_decision(
  115      current: ApprovalDecisionStatus, target: ApprovalDecisionStatus
  116  ) -> ApprovalDecisionStatus:
  117      allowed = {
  118          ApprovalDecisionStatus.PENDING: {
  119              ApprovalDecisionStatus.APPROVED,
  120              ApprovalDecisionStatus.DENIED,
  121              ApprovalDecisionStatus.EXPIRED,
  122              ApprovalDecisionStatus.CANCELLED,
  123          }
  124      }
  125      if target not in allowed.get(current, set()):
  126          raise ApprovalTransitionError(f"illegal decision transition: {current} -> {target}")
  127      return target
  128  
  129  
  130  def transition_execution(
  131      current: ApprovalExecutionStatus, target: ApprovalExecutionStatus
  132  ) -> ApprovalExecutionStatus:
  133      allowed = {
  134          ApprovalExecutionStatus.NOT_STARTED: {
  135              ApprovalExecutionStatus.CLAIMED,
  136              ApprovalExecutionStatus.FAILED,
  137              ApprovalExecutionStatus.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME,
  138          },
  139          ApprovalExecutionStatus.CLAIMED: {
  140              ApprovalExecutionStatus.SUCCEEDED,
  141              ApprovalExecutionStatus.FAILED,
  142              ApprovalExecutionStatus.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME,
  143          },
  144      }
  145      if target not in allowed.get(current, set()):
  146          raise ApprovalTransitionError(f"illegal execution transition: {current} -> {target}")
  147      return target
  148  
  149  
  150  __all__ = [
  151      "ApprovalDecisionStatus",
  152      "ApprovalExecutionStatus",
  153      "ApprovalTransitionError",
  154      "canonicalize_arguments",
  155      "compute_logical_action_id",
  156      "transition_decision",
  157      "transition_execution",
  158  ]

1  """The only place in AgentHub that speaks MCP.
    2  
    3  Everything the MCP Python SDK exposes — the transport, the handshake, the
    4  session, ``tools/list`` and its cursor — is confined to this module. Callers
    5  receive normalized dataclasses and stable failure codes, so the service, the
    6  API layer and the tests never import an SDK type and never have to reason
    7  about protocol versions.
    8  
    9  Three properties are enforced here rather than left to callers:
   10  
   11  * the bearer token exists only for the duration of one outbound call, and
   12    appears in no long-lived object, log line or exception;
   13  * every remote interaction is bounded in time, in tool count and in bytes;
   14  * a remote failure is reported as a code from :data:`FAILURE_CODES`, never as
   15    an exception message, a URL, a response body or a remote stack trace.

  158  class DispatchState(StrEnum):
  159      """How much is known about whether the remote was actually asked to act.
  160  
  161      This is the whole basis of the WRITE safety story. A request that provably
  162      never left this process can be failed outright, because nothing happened.
